lib/page-schema.ts.name: Page frontmatter schema
lib/page-schema.ts.description: Extends the Fumadocs page schema: title and description required, content_type one of seven values, author and audience fields optional.

lib/reference-schema.ts.name: Glossary frontmatter schema
lib/reference-schema.ts.description: Requires id and title and allows sortAs on every reference collection entry; the MDX body is the definition.

lib/references.ts.name: Glossary registry
lib/references.ts.description: Registers the glossary collection for Term hover references and looks an entry up by id or lists them sorted by sortAs.

lib/source.ts.name: Content loader
lib/source.ts.description: Creates the single Fumadocs loader every route reads, applies sidebar_label to the page tree, and names each page's image, markdown and preview URLs.

source.config.ts.name: Collection definitions
source.config.ts.description: Defines the dynamic docs and glossary collections with their frontmatter schemas and the shared MDX options.
